review.changesAllowed: Register and review report only; existing content, timestamps and publication states are unchanged.

sourceUrlPolicy: URLs were opened during research. Use verified section anchors where available; otherwise the exact article URL plus named section is recorded. No unobserved fragment IDs are invented. PDF page fragments are one-based viewer page numbers, not printed page labels.

sources.title: AMB2018-03: Benchmark Physical Property Measurements for Material Extrusion Additive Manufacturing of Polycarbonate
sources.verification: AI read the official source; no independent human review

sources.title: 3D print a design
sources.verification: AI read the official source; no independent human review

sections.title: Export to a 3MF, STL, or OBJ file

supportedScope: STL is a unitless triangulated surface format. Unit choice and mesh refinement settings should be checked in the export workflow.
limitations: Fusion documentation describes its software behavior; it is not proof of a complete mesh, physical tolerance or another application’s exact export behavior.

sources.title: Mesh modify tools
sources.verification: AI read the official source; no independent human review
supportedScope: Fusion provides operations to reduce mesh face count, fill holes and convert a mesh to a solid or surface body.
limitations: Creating a watertight mesh or filling a hole does not recover the true missing geometry.
A converted solid is not necessarily a meaningful design-history model, and software operations do not validate physical accuracy.

sources.title: How to 3D scan with Artec Leo: The complete guide
sources.verification: AI read the official source; no independent human review

sections.title: Before you scan: object, environment, technique → Check the object; Check the environment; Scanning technique

supportedScope: Surface appearance, object stability and access around the object affect optical scanning preparation. Reflective and transparent surfaces can be challenging.
limitations: Operational distances, angles, scan error values and HD-mode claims apply to Artec Leo; the workshop’s scanner model is unknown.
Do not infer that spray is safe for a customer object. Surface-treatment suitability and permission must be considered for the actual object.

openEvidenceRequirements.required: Supplier, exact product/grade, current TDS/SDS revision, conditioning and actual process evidence before quantitative performance claims.
Owner/equipment records for scanner model, measurement uncertainty, print processes, build envelope, tolerances and qualified stock.

Qualified human review for medical, food contact, pressure/sealing, electrical/fire, lifting/guarding, automotive safety, aviation and defense claims. Jurisdiction and actual intended use must be identified.
Owner-verified registered operator and applicable legal notices; no inferred identity or legal approval.
Current owner-approved commercial evidence for prices, stock, lead times, courier coverage and any SLA.
Rights/permission evidence for customer-supplied designs and reproduction where applicable; manufacturer marketing is not legal clearance.
A named competent reviewer and genuine review evidence, if the release gate requires independent human approval. This AI register cannot satisfy that gate.

automationRecommendations.action: Store sourceIds and claimIds separately from generic page links; display citations close to only the supported statement or in a clearly scoped source note.
Validate all referenced source IDs, HTTPS URLs, named sections, supported scope, limitations and date. Never satisfy claim evidence merely because a source list is nonempty.
Flag new numeric units, currency, delivery-time promises, certification/approval, clinical/food/critical-use and stock language. Review negation and context before marking a violation.
Access dates belong to the register; never overwrite authored reviewed_at, updated_at, publication state or human approval with this research date.
Build organization/local schema from owner-confirmed records; prevent branch, hours, rating, price, certification and stock inference from geographic or manufacturer links.
Recheck source applicability when a technical claim or material grade changes; commercial facts require separate owner confirmation. Automated link health is not a technical re-review.

auditObservations.method: Automated patterns over all effective content and authoring JSON, followed by AI contextual review of higher-risk matches and recurring claims; not independent human review.
illustrativeUnitMatchScope: maketyanimda /rehber/mimari-maket-olcek-secimi comparison rows: 60 cm, 30 cm, 15 cm
auditObservations.caveat: Absence of matched promises is a bounded audit finding, not proof of exhaustive compliance. Citations do not verify all sentences on a page.
